findings.evidence: `grep -n "Bialgebra\." CounitConnectedComponent.lean` yields only `counitAlgHom`/`counitAlgHom_apply` hits; `counit_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent`'s proof is just 'idempotent not in `ker f` ⇒ `f e = 1`', with no comultiplication or coassociativity input.
findings.fix: State the whole API for `(f : H →ₐ[k] k)` in `TauCeti.AlgHom` next to `kernelPoint` (e.g. `AlgHom.kernelPointConnectedComponentIdempotent`, `..._Ideal`, `f e = 1`, `Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ`), and let the bialgebra case be `f := counitAlgHom k H` — no separate declarations needed. This mirrors the existing split: general `AlgHom.kernel*` in `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/TangentSpace/Affine.lean`, bialgebra specialization in `Tangent/Scheme.lean`.
findings.issue: `[Bialgebra k H]` is not used mathematically: every declaration reaches `H` only through `_root_.Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k H : H →ₐ[k] k` (lines 85-93, 123, 133, 141, 149) and `augmentationPoint k H = AlgHom.kernelPoint (counitAlgHom k H)`. The results hold verbatim for an arbitrary augmentation `f : H →ₐ[k] k`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib `Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Noetherian.lean:30`: `instance : NoetherianSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)` under `[IsNoetherianRing R]`; TauCeti `Topology/NoetherianSpace/ConnectedComponents.lean`: `instance instLocallyConnectedSpaceOfNoetherianSpace [NoetherianSpace X] : LocallyConnectedSpace X`.
findings.fix: Assume `[IsNoetherianRing H]` (or, matching `Connected/Component.lean`, `[LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum H)]`). Instance search then supplies the topology hypothesis and all `letI : IsNoetherianRing H := ...`/`unfold` scaffolding disappears, making the wrappers `rfl`.
findings.issue: `[Algebra.FiniteType k H]` is stronger than what is used: it appears only through `Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k H` in a `letI` inside every def and proof (lines 57, 63, 72, 81, 98, 106, 115, 124, 158, 168). The general file is parameterized by `LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)`, which is strictly weaker than Noetherian, itself weaker than finite type over a field.

findings.evidence: Each proof body is `unfold …; exact PrimeSpectrum.<same lemma> (augmentationPoint k H)` — see lines 63-65, 72-74, 106-108, 115-117, 158-161, 168-171.
findings.fix: Delete these six and use the general lemmas from `Connected/Component.lean` applied to the augmentation point; retain only the genuinely new content (`f e = 1`, `ideal ≤ ker f`, the `liftₐ` and its `_mk`/`_comp_mk` rules).
findings.issue: Special-case duplication: `isIdempotentElem_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (61), `basicOpen_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (69), `counitConnectedComponentIdeal_eq_span` (103), `zeroLocus_counitConnectedComponentIdeal` (112), `primeSpectrumCounitConnectedComponentHomeomorph` (155) and `..._apply` (164) each restate a `PrimeSpectrum.*_connectedComponent*` lemma at the definitionally equal argument `augmentationPoint k H`, adding no mathematics.

summary: The specialized file is stated one level too narrowly: the bialgebra structure is unused (everything factors through the augmentation `counitAlgHom : H →ₐ[k] k`) and `Algebra.FiniteType` is stronger than the `IsNoetherianRing`/`LocallyConnectedSpace` the general file actually needs. Six of its lemmas are verbatim restatements of the general `PrimeSpectrum` API at a definitional wrapper.
